title: vaultCdpHandoff
responsibility: Guards the session's CDP handoff: pipe-only Chromium launch, a Unix socket endpoint, and connections only from the lease's session user with its one-time token.

inputs.name: vaultCdpHandoff.handoff
inputs.description: The issued handoff: its lease state, the session OS user ID, the SHA-256 digest of the one-time token and the Unix socket path.

inputs.name: vaultCdpHandoff.connection
inputs.description: One connection on the CDP socket: kernel-reported peer UID (null when unknown), the presented token and the time.

inputs.name: vaultChromiumArgs.args
inputs.description: Chromium launch arguments for the login container.

inputs.name: vaultCdpEndpoint.socketPath
inputs.description: Absolute path of the lease Unix socket, without colons or spaces.

outputs.name: vaultCdpHandoff
outputs.description: Allowed, or refused with the reason: ended lease, another OS user, or a wrong token.

outputs.name: vaultChromiumArgs
outputs.description: The same arguments when they use --remote-debugging-pipe and open no TCP debugging endpoint.

outputs.name: vaultCdpEndpoint
outputs.description: The ws+unix address that Playwright connectOverCDP accepts for the socket.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when Chromium arguments lack the pipe or open a TCP debugging endpoint, or the socket path is not absolute and plain.
